premise: Shy Ammonite hides in her shell when Dragonfly zooms up to say hello; Turtle swims over and tucks into her own shell beside her, and the two of them peek out together — and the hello is easy after all.
inspiration: Andersen's shy-heart tales (the timid one coaxed by kindness), turned: the friend doesn't coax, she hides too.
lesson: Sometimes the kindest help is to keep someone company.

en-US.title: Two Shells
en-US.text: {ammonite:enter} {ammonite:go to lagoon} Little Ammonite lived in the lagoon, and she was very, very shy. {sfx:zip} ZIP! {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:float loop 0.3} Dragonfly came zooming up, her wings all a-shimmer. {dragonfly:go to ammonite} [excited] "Hello, Ammonite!" {ammonite:face surprised} Whoop! {ammonite:live hide hold} Ammonite tucked herself into her shell. Only the stripes were showing. {dragonfly:face sad} "Oh," said Dragonfly. "Maybe she doesn't like me." {turtle:enter} Turtle had seen it all. {turtle:go to ammonite by swim} {sfx:slide} She slid into the water and swam over, slow and calm. She didn't say a word. She just tucked her own head in, {turtle:live peek hold} right beside Ammonite, and peeked out with only her eyes. [whispers] "It's cosy in here, isn't it?" Two shells, side by side. Then, very slowly, {ammonite:live hide resume} one little face came out, {turtle:live peek resume} and then another. {ammonite:face happy} {turtle:face happy} {dragonfly:face happy} [gently] {dragonfly:live wave} Dragonfly waved one clear wing, softly this time. "Hello," whispered Ammonite, {ammonite:live wave-tentacles} and she waved all her curly little arms. From then on, whenever Dragonfly came zipping by, two shells said hello together.

es-ES.title: Dos casitas a cuestas
es-ES.text: {ammonite:enter} {ammonite:go to lagoon} En la laguna vivía la pequeña Amonites, que era muy, muy tímida. {sfx:zip} ¡ZUUUM! {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:float loop 0.3} Libélula llegó zumbando, con las alas brillantes. {dragonfly:go to ammonite} [excited] —¡Hola, Amonites! {ammonite:face surprised} ¡Uy! {ammonite:live hide hold} Amonites se escondió en su concha en un santiamén. Solo se veían las rayas. {dragonfly:face sad} —Vaya —dijo Libélula—. A lo mejor no le caigo bien. {turtle:enter} Tortuga lo había visto todo. {turtle:go to ammonite by swim} {sfx:slide} Se deslizó en el agua y se acercó nadando, despacito y tranquila. No dijo nada. Solo metió la cabeza {turtle:live peek hold} justo al lado de Amonites, y se asomó con los ojitos nada más. [whispers] —Aquí dentro se está calentito, ¿verdad? Una concha y un caparazón, uno junto al otro. Y entonces, muy despacio, {ammonite:live hide resume} salió una carita, {turtle:live peek resume} y luego otra. {ammonite:face happy} {turtle:face happy} {dragonfly:face happy} [gently] {dragonfly:live wave} Libélula saludó con un ala transparente, muy suavecito esta vez. —Hola —susurró Amonites, {ammonite:live wave-tentacles} y saludó con todos sus bracitos rizados. Desde entonces, cada vez que Libélula pasaba zumbando, una concha y un caparazón la saludaban a la vez.

zip.prompt: a dragonfly zipping past close by, a quick shimmering whir of wings, realistic

slide.prompt: a small turtle sliding gently into calm water, a soft slip and little ripple, realistic, close
